name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Press a pair of dumbbells from shoulder height to straight overhead, then lower them back to your shoulders.

source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows out and below your hands.
cues: Brace your stomach so your back doesn't arch.
Press straight up; don't lock your elbows hard.

prescription.note: Pick a weight you can lift for every rep with good form. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.
